name: AUTOPILOT.OI Bill Agent
description_html:
Turn Claude into your Bill Agent in 10 minutes.

Checks every medical bill against your insurance, finds the errors, writes your call scripts and tracks every bill until it's settled.

Inside: the full master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a step by step setup and your tracker. Works with Claude's free or paid plan.

Education only, not financial, legal or medical advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
